## Functions

### `PricingTable`

```ts
PricingTable(props: PricingTableProps): Html
```

Plans side by side, one of them the obvious choice. Stacks on a phone;
the action buttons line up along the bottom whatever the feature
counts. A `toggle` adds the monthly/yearly switch.

## Types

### `PricingColumns`

Plans per row from 768px up (they stack below).

- `"2"`
- `"3"`
- `"4"`

### `PricingFeature`

- `string`
- `{ label: string | Html; included?: boolean }`

### `PricingPlan`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `price` | `string | Html` | yes | The price as shown — "$12", "Free", "Let's talk". |
| `priceYearly` | `string | Html` |  | The price under the yearly toggle; without it the plan shows `price` in both. |
| `period` | `string` |  | "per seat / month" — the line under the price. |
| `description` | `string | Html` |  |  |
| `features` | `PricingFeature[]` | yes |  |
| `action` | `Html` | yes | The call to action — a `Button({ href })`. |
| `featured` | `boolean` |  | The plan to steer towards: raised, accent-framed, badged. |
| `badge` | `string` |  | A label on the card's top edge — "Most popular". |

### `PricingToggle`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monthly` | `string` | yes | Label of the first option. @default "Monthly" |
| `yearly` | `string` | yes | Label of the second option. @default "Yearly" |
| `name` | `string` |  | The radio group's name, if the choice should submit. @default "billing" |
| `note` | `string` |  | A note beside the yearly option — "save 20%". |

### `PricingTableProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plans` | `PricingPlan[]` | yes |  |
| `columns` | `PricingColumns` |  |  |
| `toggle` | `PricingToggle` |  | A monthly / yearly switch above the plans: real radios (they submit, they work without JS); pricing.js mirrors the choice to `data-billing` on the root and the stylesheet shows the matching price. Without JS both prices show, labelled. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Three plans with a yearly toggle

The toggle is a pair of radios: it submits and works without JS; pricing.js only switches which price shows.

```ts
PricingTable({
  toggle: { monthly: "Monthly", yearly: "Yearly", note: "save 20%" },
  plans: [
    {
      name: "Starter",
      price: "$0",
      period: "per month",
      features: ["10 invoices a month", { label: "Reminders", included: false }],
      action: Button({ label: "Start free", variant: "outline", href: "/signup" }),
    },
    {
      name: "Team",
      price: "$24",
      priceYearly: "$19",
      period: "per seat / month",
      features: ["Unlimited invoices", "Reminders", "Card payments"],
      action: Button({ label: "Start trial", href: "/signup?plan=team" }),
      featured: true,
      badge: "Most popular",
    },
    {
      name: "Business",
      price: "$59",
      priceYearly: "$49",
      period: "per seat / month",
      features: ["Everything in Team", "Approvals", "Priority support"],
      action: Button({ label: "Talk to sales", variant: "outline", href: "/sales" }),
    },
  ],
})
```

## Behaviour

`components/pricing/pricing.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-billing`, `data-pricing`, `data-pricing-period`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
